paper.title_en: Precision Electroweak Physics of Neutral Currents Below the Z-pole
paper.abstract_en: We report on the status and prospects of precision weak neutral current interaction measurements in fixed target scattering, atomic parity violation, as well as future collider measurements at momentum transfer $\sqrt{Q^2} \ll M_Z$, including the experiments in parity-violating electron scattering under construction at Jefferson Laboratory and at Mainz that are expected to commence data collection in the very near future.
